headline: A Han River View for the Children…"42% of High-Value Corporate Housing Is 'Imperial Staff Housing'"
summary: The National Tax Service is targeting so-called 'imperial staff housing', high-value homes held in corporate names and privately used by company owners and controlling-shareholder families. Some are in Seoul's Gangnam or have Han River views.
why: Tax enforcement on corporate asset use affects controlling shareholders of Korean conglomerates and the governance practices investors weigh when assessing them.
